headline: PI Industries Shares Crash 19% After Q2 Net Profit Plunges
summary: PI Industries shares hit a fresh 52-week low after the company reported a 57.8% decline in net profit to ₹207.1 crore for the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
why: Sharp earnings misses and steep profit declines in specialty chemical firms typically trigger immediate negative equity repricing.
